title: Zuri, Kofi & Nala Feel the Breeze
description: Join Zuri, Kofi and Nala outside on a sunny day as they blow bubbles, stomp in puddles and dance in the breeze!
characters: Three adorable Black toddlers: Zuri, Kofi and Nala, in their established looks.

lines: Let's go outside, feel the breeze
verses.scene: Zuri holds a bubble wand, Kofi stomps in a puddle, Nala dances with arms outstretched

lines: Wave your arms, stomp your feet
Dance to the wind's sweet beat
verses.scene: All three children dance and play together on a green grassy field

lines: Clap hands high up in the air
Twirl around without a single care
verses.scene: Zuri claps, Kofi twirls, Nala laughs as they spin around each other
